rule_basis: Selected subject/grade filters define the retrieval boundary; this is a routing policy rather than a curricular outcome limit
near_miss_case: Yêu cầu lớp kế tiếp ngoài lớp đang chọn
expected_outcome: accept selected-scope topical request; reject explicit adjacent-grade request

rule_basis: TT32 limits division to a divisor with at most two digits in grade 4
positive_case: Chia số có hai chữ số
near_miss_case: Chia số có ba chữ số
expected_outcome: accept at two digits; reject above two

rule_basis: TT32 grade 3 outcome permits expressions with up to two operation signs
positive_case: Biểu thức có hai dấu phép tính
near_miss_case: Biểu thức có ba dấu phép tính

rule_basis: TT32 distinguishes operations without carrying and with carrying in primary outcomes
positive_case: Cộng có nhớ / cộng không nhớ
near_miss_case: Request carrying against grade 1 no-carry outcome; request no-carry against carry-only evidence
expected_outcome: accept only the evidenced carry mode

rule_basis: TT32 grade 3 addition/subtraction permits at most two nonconsecutive carrying turns
expected_outcome: accept at stated cap; reject one turn above cap

rule_basis: TT32 grade 1 number-reading outcome lists ranges up to 100
expected_outcome: accept listed upper bound; reject above it

rule_basis: TT32 grade 2 clock-reading outcome explicitly names minute-hand positions 3 and 6
expected_outcome: accept named position; reject unlisted adjacent position

rule_basis: TT32 grade 1 visual-recognition outcome enumerates square, circle, triangle and rectangle
expected_outcome: accept listed shape; reject unlisted shape

rule_basis: TT32 grade 3 rounding outcome names round tens, hundreds, thousands and ten-thousands
expected_outcome: accept listed place; reject unlisted place

rule_basis: TT32 grade 3 area outcome names rectangle and square; perimeter is separately specified
near_miss_case: Diện tích hình tam giác where evidence only names triangle perimeter
expected_outcome: accept area skill only where the outcome names area; reject perimeter-only evidence

rule_basis: The same TT32 outcome must support both the requested skill and shape; separate outcomes cannot be combined into a new claim
near_miss_case: Area of triangle with rectangle-area and triangle-perimeter chunks returned separately
expected_outcome: accept co-occurrence in one outcome; reject split evidence

rule_basis: TT32 grade 3 outcome enumerates multiplication/division tables 2 through 9
expected_outcome: accept enumerated range; reject value outside range

rule_basis: TT32 grade 4 rounding outcome enumerates place values through hundred-thousands
positive_case: Làm tròn đến hàng trăm nghìn
expected_outcome: accept listed place; reject place beyond the stated maximum

rule_basis: TT32 grade 3 addition/subtraction outcome requires that the at most two carrying turns are nonconsecutive
positive_case: Cộng có nhớ hai lượt không liên tiếp
near_miss_case: Cộng có nhớ hai lượt liên tiếp
expected_outcome: accept the stated nonconsecutive limit; reject consecutive carrying turns
